changes: Port the proved GNU cp archive/reflink path for physical overlay backing directories and private Sysbox-managed volumes.
Require the actual single-lower overlay layout, explicit manager root and saved ID-mapped Sysbox mount identities; reject unowned external binds.
Capture both lower and upper independently rather than assuming the administrator-provided lower is already an immutable template.
Add complete content, mode, UID/GID, mtime, link, device and xattr digests, foreign-mount rejection and independent-inode checks.
Hash hardlinked payloads once per inode inside each frozen-tree scan while retaining every path and link relationship.
Extract the ordinary complete retained-source checkpoint options, mapped image ownership and final regular-file ownership checks.
Use the same pinned modern runc library as ramctl, without its experiment switches, fixed paths, pre-dump or lazy-inheritance modes.
Supply a per-capture CRIU configuration through a private raw state copy; preserve the original opaque Sysbox state and verify it is unchanged after dump.
Keep vendor configuration types inside this adapter. The caller supplies original kernel handles through the guarded worker.
Adapt the sealed-memfd request pattern to an application-independent retained-source capture worker.
Bind requests to the unchanged sandbox record, original PID/cgroup/directory handles and the exact CRIU executable.
Retain the operation lock in the worker, persist intent before CRIU starts and leave failed or unacknowledged capture under the source guard.
Extract the source guard protocol, PID-fd checks, safe thaw, unsafe hold and controller fallback.
Replace fixed experiment paths with a persisted sandbox record, its exact hash and an original controller-root descriptor.
Dispatch the helper explicitly through a private re-exec command; do not run helpers from package initialization.
Preserve capture-entry, intermediate-return and final acknowledged-completion semantics.
Carry all eleven original native controller/helper/tracer and disarm scenarios with their original assertions.
Build the source cgroup from a saved Factorybox record and use generated capture evidence paths instead of fixed experiment paths.
Add rejection of a foreign cgroup bind mount and an actual CLI-helper cycle on a real Sysbox process.
Port process-start identity parsing and strict cgroup counter parsing.
Retain the complete owned-thread check while traversing through directory descriptors with depth, count and mount-identity bounds.
Freeze only the guarded original cgroup; do not call Sysbox manager pause/resume.
Port the reference's cgroup2 device, inode and mount-identity check to the local lifecycle controller.
Generate cgroup paths from persisted runtime IDs and save their kernel identity before starting Sysbox.
Retirement here only removes the exact empty directory. The complete replay-tree cleanup and its original regressions remain in the sealed reference.
Extracted only pagemap codec or complete logical byte comparison; no prefetch or harness policy.
Package and private identifiers renamed; original comparison and rejection assertions retained.
